12.t: Working with data: concentration and conductivity
q: Read the current at 2 g per 100 mL.
More salt, higher current; the rise slows down at high concentrations.
Explain why more salt gives a bigger current.
More dissolved ions are free to move and carry charge through the solution.
Name two control variables, and explain why each matters.
Distance between the electrodes (and their size) and the voltage (also temperature): each changes the current on its own, so it would hide the effect of concentration.
